race.comment: Tricky race. CHILLCUZ (8) returns and usually races his best fresh. Has trialled strongly in readiness and reunites with the claimer to get her in well at the weights. Watch for her bursting through. Without doing a great deal of winning, BRIMARVI ROSEMARIE (6) is as consistent as they come. Draws the A1 for Holder who will give her every chance. Like her on the quick back-up. HOT STRUT (2) has been less effective in her last two but she did have excuses last time. Her early prep form reads strongly though, so if she can get back to that level she can give this a big shake. It's impossible to knock the form of BREAKFAST (1), who shoots for three on the bounce after tough on-pace wins. Can quickly offset the wide alley and the 3kg is a big help. Not dismissing. TRANTORO (11) stuck on gamely into a close sixth when resuming here two weeks ago. With improvement to come she's in the mix.
